title: Chapter 204: Sweeping The Enemy Territory
content:
Chapter 204: Sweeping The Enemy Territory

The last army directly under the Spirit God Green Department was quickly destroyed under the attack of the Zerg destroyers and flying dragons.

Some of their strong men died in the hands of high-star Zerg flying dragons and destroyers.

The 20 Zerg queens, exhausted their energy, successfully controlled about 3,000 soldiers directly under the Spirit God Green Department, as well as a large number of heavy armored ground dragon mounts.

Five thousand Zerg cockroaches rushed to the front line of the battle and attacked the ordinary army of the bear goblin tribe.

They were like battlefield cleaning machines, and wherever the corrosive flames were sprayed, they would become clean.

Each branch of the Zerg army was a veritable killing machine on the battlefield. Originally, these army of the bear goblin tribe that had defeated the Tengu tribe was completely destroyed in front of the Zerg without any waves.

Nearly one million ordinary troops of the bear goblin tribe, plus 300,000 direct troops of the Spirit God Green Department that specifically targeted the Zerg, were completely wiped out by the Zerg.

The total combat time of this battle was not long. When the war ended, it was still morning.

First, both armies were dispatched early and took action at dawn.

Second, the Zerg army upgraded by Wu Qing had a very high killing effect, and the Zerg tactics were also very targeted.

The Zerg started with only a few minutes of sheep attack, but they used the powerful single-target attack ability of the Zerg Queen and the unparalleled tacit cooperation of the entire Zerg army to kill all the enemy's most important core personnel, the evil god priest!

Then they used the super-strong area killing attack of the three-star explosive mosquito to wipe out all the evil god priests of the bear goblin tribe.

This was equivalent to instantly interrupting the backbone of the bear goblin army, so that none of the various terrible means they prepared could be used.

If the evil god priest and the priest team of the bear goblin tribe had always existed, it would have become extremely difficult for the Zerg to win today's war.

Just think about it, ordinary bear goblin soldiers can enter a super frenzy state with their strength increased several times under the blessing of the magic of the evil god priests. It is conceivable how terrible the magic of the three five-star evil god priests is.

These evil god priests and the priest teams are all super powerful and super personnel. If they are given the opportunity to give full play, I wonder to what extent they can strengthen this army of more than one million.

Especially the army directly under the spiritual god green department, which is already very strong, if they are blessed with a few super magic, the loss of the Zerg army will be incalculable.

The tactics used by Wu Qing to command the Zerg are like hitting a snake. If you hit the snake's vital point, no matter how the snake jumps behind, it will be a dying struggle.

Wu Qing consumed a lot of gas resources to upgrade all Zerg destroyers, and then increased the proportion of one-star flying dragons among the 60,000 Zerg flying dragons, which is the guarantee for the Zerg army to output a large amount of firepower in a short period of time.

In one round of their attack, tens of thousands of enemies would be killed or injured. If it were not for the restraint of the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department under the blessing of divine arts, the ordinary army of one million bear goblins would not be able to withstand several rounds of attacks from the Zerg army.

In order to deal with stronger enemies, Wu Qing has increased the combat power of the Zerg to a level that the original enemies could not match. The Zerg army and the army of the bear goblins in this area are no longer on the same level.

The lords and armies of the alliance were stunned to watch this war that was beyond their imagination from beginning to end. They could no longer express their feelings at the moment in words.

After the war, a large amount of supplies and equipment were left on the battlefield, especially the green armor and heavy crossbows equipped by the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department, which were very sophisticated and of high value.

The lords and armies of the alliance thought that their task would be to clean up the battlefield. To their surprise, what they waited for was the combat order given to them by Wu Qing.

Based on the intelligence collected by the Zerg, Wu Qing designated an area in the territory of the Bugbears for the Alliance Army, and asked the Alliance Army to go and recapture these territories.

In these territories, there are several small cities and some strongholds. With all the troops withdrawn, the defense capabilities of these places are very weak, which is very suitable for the Alliance Army to practice and improve their strength.

The cause and effect between the Alliance Army and Wu Qing are getting deeper and deeper. There is no need for the Zerg to come forward. The enemies killed by the Alliance Army can be converted into resources by the system.

It is still very early now, and the Zerg army cannot be idle.

The Zerg flying dragon group, excluding the parts that were severely damaged in the war, still has more than 50,000 people. They are going to sweep the main cities in the territory of the Bugbears.

Now the regular army of the Bugbears has been almost withdrawn. They either fell in the stationed cities and on the road to assembly yesterday, or fell on the battlefield today. The remaining armed militias can't resist the attack of the terrifying Zerg flying dragon group at all.

The millions of Zerg puppies that survived on the battlefield were all dispatched. They spread out and, based on intelligence, swept away all the remaining enemies on the ground.

The Zerg Destroyers with the strongest firepower, as well as Zerg Hydralisks, Cockroaches, Stealth Spiders, Exploding Mosquitoes, Queens and other troops, had to return to the Zerg territory to rest and recover.

Wu Qing also planned to use this powerful army to enter the underground world again and beat up the ghouls.

Wu Qing also assigned combat missions to the Daxia cavalry led by Wu Cong to help them improve their recovery strength.

The Zerg puppies and Zerg dragons left quickly, and the remaining Zerg troops began to withdraw to the Zerg territory.

On the battlefield here, just leave a few puppies to guard it. Wu Qing will send people to clean up the battlefield. The current Daxia Territory is no longer short of manpower.

…

The lords of the Menghe Alliance were very happy to receive Wu Qing's combat order. They could not participate in the battle just now. Now the small-scale, low-intensity battles to clear the remaining enemies and recover the territory are just right for them to practice.

The alliance army, with the continuous expansion of the army in each territory, now has a force of nearly 300,000.

With Wu Qing's strong support, this army is full of well-equipped regular troops. Although some are uneven, at least they are all armored soldiers, much stronger than the armed militia of the bear goblin tribe.

Among them, the elite troops are extremely well-equipped, and their combat effectiveness is no worse than that of the soldiers of the Lingshen Green Department's direct army without the blessing of the evil god sacrifice.

Wu Qing only gave a combat order, and the specific combat methods were all left to the alliance army to decide. Even intelligence was not provided, and they needed to do pre-war reconnaissance by themselves.

"Since we are asked to go to war, there must be no major threat!"

"The current alliance army is still in the construction stage, this is an opportunity for actual combat training!"

"We must make good use of this opportunity to comprehensively improve the strength of the alliance army!"

"Lord Hu Wei and I will still be in charge of the command. All lords have the right to lead and oppose the army. Do you have any objections?"

Meng said to the lords of the alliance.

He took the command without hesitation and arranged Hu Wei to assist. This was consistent with Wu Qing's last arrangement and was also in line with the actual situation. No lord objected.

"Everyone has no objection, so let's decide it!"

"All actions on the battlefield must be under command. If anyone dares to disobey military orders, don't blame me for being ruthless!"

"Send scouts to the target area for reconnaissance first. We will discuss the battle plan while marching!"

"I guess this combat mission will not make us too easy. Everyone must take it seriously!"

"..."

Meng and the lords of the alliance quickly discussed and set off. They marched in a hurry in the morning and now they marched quickly. This is a huge test for those soldiers of the alliance army who are not strong enough.

Fortunately, these soldiers have inherited the Nine Changes of Heavenly Silkworms. With the assistance of the Heavenly Silkworms in their bodies, this kind of forced march is also a kind of cultivation.

They will only become stronger and stronger, and will not be exhausted.

The lords of the alliance have seen the power of the Nine Changes of Heavenly Silkworms, and with the example of the five major territories of the alliance, they went to Wu Qing yesterday in Mengzhong City and received enough Heavenly Silkworms.

When they learned that they would participate in the war today, they had all the troops in the territory switched to the Nine Changes of Heavenly Silkworms.

Now, except for a few special personnel, all the alliance troops have practiced the Nine Changes of Heavenly Silkworms.

The Queen of Insects did not limit the ability of the Heavenly Silkworms in the bodies of the soldiers of the alliance army. Now, with the assistance of the Heavenly Silkworms in their bodies, these soldiers of the alliance army can practice walking, sitting, and lying down, and their strength is improving very quickly.

As long as they participate in the battle and plunder the enemy's energy and luck from the battlefield, their strength will increase at an even more amazing speed.

The strength of the five major territories and some territories of the alliance is not weak in this area. Their scouts are the elite among the elites, with rich reconnaissance experience, and they quickly brought back intelligence on some target areas.

The target location chosen by Wu Qing for the alliance army is the closest, and the enemy's power distribution is also very suitable for the alliance army to fight. It is purely a real-combat exercise and not difficult.

In the words of the game, this is a novice task.

"There is a small town and three strongholds in this location that has been explored. There are no regular troops stationed, all of them are armed militias!"

"The combat is not difficult. What we need to consider now is the combat efficiency!"

"In order to seize the time, we will not discuss too many tactical issues. We have basically never experienced attacking other territories. What we say is just talk on paper!"

"Let's push a few strongholds along the way, summarize some experience, and then adjust the tactics. How about it?"

Meng held the simple map drawn based on the scout's intelligence and discussed the war with the lords of the alliance.

"No problem! Let's fight a few games first!"

"The enemy is very weak now, so be careful to reduce losses!"

"That's right, we all have the precious silkworms of the Zerg. As long as we have time and opportunities to grow, we can all become elites!"

"..."

The alliance lords agreed, and an alliance army of nearly 300,000 soldiers rushed to a stronghold of less than 10,000 bear goblins, and surrounded this small stronghold in three layers.
